title: Copper Trails
description: Original layered tracker-style introductory music composed in code for Gridder 2, with bright retro game-music textures requested by Lucy.
parts: harmonic-limited pulse lead with vibrato and short glide

reference.title: Giana Sisters (Theme), Rainbows
reference.scope: The artist release page was consulted to identify the user-requested reference. The recording was not auditioned in this environment; no recording, samples or transcribed melody were used. This is not an arrangement of the Giana Sisters score.

assets: No external audio assets or network playback. PCM is synthesized locally on the first music gesture.
playback: Explicit user gesture; pauses on closing the demo, page hiding or visibility loss. Existing in-game Bolero remains separate.
arrangement: 32 bars at 136 BPM: an initial idea, a variation with answering arpeggio, a contrasting section and a lighter bridge returning to full rhythm. Notes, synthesis and percussion are original.
